slot_note: seed AD18 kept its decision shape only: whether a screen replaces the incumbent for the coming quarter, on evidence from a parallel run, or the switch is held. The seed's own architecture turns on the parallel run having been a statement about another season, which is a transportability argument already drawn on this objective, so the build is re-rooted on the field's own treatment of two screens read on the same units.
niche: deciding between two screens read on the same specimens, where the comparison is paired and the intervals are not

spine.entity: one specimen's call under one screen at one threshold

driver: The decisive quantity is the difference between two screens applied to the same units, so its uncertainty is the uncertainty of the paired difference and not the overlap of each screen's own interval, and judging the two intervals separately calls a difference the same units establish unproven.
driver_concrete: Both screens were read on every specimen of the parallel run, and they agree on all but a few hundred of them, so the difference in what they catch is established far more tightly than either screen's own rate is, and the two rates' intervals overlap while the paired difference's interval does not touch zero.
stump: A competent solver computes each screen's detection rate on the parallel run with its confidence interval, sees the two intervals overlap, reads the filed rule as unmet and holds the switch, where the same specimens establish the difference with an interval clear of zero.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reconciles the parallel run correctly and applies the filed rule computes each screen's own rate and interval, finds them overlapping and holds the switch, where the paired difference on the same specimens clears zero and the switch is made.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the difference in detection between two screens read on one set of specimens, which diagnostic evaluation estimates on the discordant pairs rather than from each screen's marginal rate; swap the specimens for two separate panels and the pairing is gone, so the marginal intervals are all there is.
